title: GS21 U in the distance-to-distress index (b~ - 0.5 z~)^2 with a continuous firm-level debt capacity: exposure +0.1, bounded (cap 4), price 4; the mirror of the hump gvylqz5g4
question: Does the leverage-index hump reach room 30% and a fair gap of +0.029 with the bound removed or a higher price of y risk?
notes:
WHY (2026-11-06). gvylqz5g4 (the same index with loading -0.1, a hump) has a fair gap of +0.147 (t 12.7, 10/10), the largest in GS21. This flips the sign: firms far from the middle of the leverage-minus-productivity index on either side (over-levered relative to productivity, or under-levered) carry the most exposure. The bounded factor h_e(y) caps the exposure at 4x either way.

PRECOMMITMENT STATUS: precommitted=false; ids filled from the Quest build log by the solve script before any seed runs.

PREDICTION (2026-11-06): if the hump's room comes from the curvature itself, the U has room 20% or more and a fair gap at or above +0.029; if it comes from the hump's sign (middle leverage most exposed, extremes least), the U is null like gvylqun5. FALSIFIED (as a U) if room is at or below 10% on three seeds.
